knowledge.name: Feature Degradation Through Dimmer Control
knowledge.description: Temporarily reduce optional functionality to protect critical response-time goals during constrained conditions.
benefits: reduces workload without completely denying service
tradeoffs: quality experienced by users may decline
constraints: optional and mandatory functionality must be distinguishable
dimmer bounds must be explicit

requirement_reason: Human oversight and architect approval are explicitly required.

knowledge.name: Human Approval and Escalation
knowledge.description: Keep humans responsible for final design-time architecture approval and provide an escalation point when autonomous runtime recovery cannot find an acceptable plan.
benefits: preserves human authority over architectural decisions
provides a fallback when autonomous recovery is exhausted
tradeoffs: human involvement may increase decision latency
operator availability may be required in deployed systems
constraints: the prototype must distinguish real human interaction from simulated escalation

knowledge.name: Centralized Adaptation Controller
knowledge.description: Use one logical controller to coordinate runtime adaptation decisions for the managed system.
benefits: makes policy enforcement easier to inspect
tradeoffs: may scale poorly for highly distributed systems
constraints: controller must remain available
runtime state must be observable from the controller

requirement_reason: Agentic control requires bounded replanning and recovery.

knowledge.name: Bounded Replanning
knowledge.description: Allow an agent to reconsider failed plans but enforce a maximum number of autonomous recovery attempts.
tradeoffs: retry bounds may terminate before a feasible plan is found
constraints: retry limit must be explicit
each revised plan must be safety-checked again

requirement_reason: Trusted constraints require a deterministic safety validation layer.

knowledge.name: Deterministic Safety Gate
knowledge.description: Place a deterministic policy-validation component between AI-generated adaptation plans and system effectors.
benefits: prevents known policy violations from reaching effectors
separates generative reasoning from trusted enforcement
tradeoffs: incorrect rules may reject useful plans
cannot guarantee properties outside encoded constraints
constraints: hard constraints must be machine-checkable
all executable plans must pass through the safety gate

requirement_reason: The requested system includes a runtime self-adaptation controller.

knowledge.name: MAPE-K Feedback Loop
knowledge.description: Organize runtime adaptation around Monitor, Analyze, Plan, and Execute activities that share knowledge.
benefits: provides clear locations for monitoring, diagnosis, planning, and execution
tradeoffs: control-loop latency may affect adaptation speed
constraints: runtime monitoring must be available
effectors must expose approved adaptation actions

knowledge.name: Decentralized Adaptation Control
knowledge.description: Distribute adaptation responsibilities among multiple coordinating controllers or agents.
applicability: systems without a single global controller
tradeoffs: global safety enforcement becomes more complex
constraints: controllers require coordination mechanisms
consistency requirements must be defined

requirement_reason: Runtime adaptation memory is explicitly required.

knowledge.name: Runtime Adaptation Memory
knowledge.description: Store previous adaptation states, decisions, safety verdicts, and observed outcomes for later retrieval.
benefits: allows previous adaptation experience to inform later decisions
supports inspection of prior decisions and outcomes
can distinguish successful and partially successful actions
constraints: current trusted constraints must override retrieved experience
retrieved experience must not directly trigger effectors

knowledge.name: Post-Execution Validation
knowledge.description: Observe the managed system after an adaptation action and compare the actual effect against the intended goal.
benefits: distinguishes proposed actions from observed effects
supports PASS, PARTIAL, and FAIL outcome semantics
provides evidence for future adaptation memory
tradeoffs: effects may take time to become observable
constraints: outcomes should be based on observed state rather than assumed action success

requirement_reason: Design scope explicitly requires LLM-supported architecture reasoning.

knowledge.name: LLM Architecture Reasoning Component
knowledge.description: Use an LLM for requirement interpretation, architectural alternative generation, trade-off explanation, and rationale generation.
tradeoffs: outputs may be incorrect or inconsistent
architectural decisions cannot be accepted without validation
constraints: LLM output must not be treated as authoritative
important decisions require validation and human approval

requirement_reason: Multiple weighted quality attributes require explicit trade-off analysis.

knowledge.name: Weighted Quality-Attribute Trade-off Analysis
knowledge.description: Evaluate candidate architectures against explicit quality attributes using architect-defined weights and explain the trade-offs rather than selecting solely from an LLM preference.
benefits: allows architects to inspect how priorities affect ranking
tradeoffs: numeric scores simplify complex architectural judgments
results depend on selected criteria and weights
constraints: weights must be explicitly documented
scores require rationale
the highest numerical score must not automatically bypass architect validation

requirement_reason: Design scope explicitly requires architectural RAG.

knowledge.name: Architectural Knowledge Retrieval
knowledge.description: Retrieve relevant architectural knowledge before asking an LLM to reason about architecture design decisions.
benefits: grounds architectural reasoning in an explicit knowledge source
allows retrieved evidence to be inspected
tradeoffs: irrelevant knowledge may bias architectural decisions
constraints: retrieved knowledge must remain advisory
important design constraints must be represented explicitly

requirement_reason: Architecture decisions require inspectable rationale and ADRs.

knowledge.name: Architecture Decision Record
knowledge.description: Record an architectural decision together with its context, considered alternatives, selected option, rationale, and consequences.
constraints: generated rationale must correspond to the actual selected architecture
